name: MenuItemDivider

props.name: backgroundToken
props.description: Specify the background token to use. Default is 'layer'.

props.name: border
props.description: Specify whether a border should be rendered on the popover

props.name: containerRef
props.description: The ref of the containing element, used for positioning and alignment of the menu

props.name: menuAlignment
props.description: Specify how the menu should align with the button element

props.name: mode
props.description: The mode of this menu. Defaults to full. `full` supports nesting and selectable menu items, but no icons. `basic` supports icons but no nesting or selectable menu items. **This prop is not intended for use and will be set by the respective implementation (like useContextMenu, MenuButton, and ComboButton).**

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the Menu is open or not.

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Menu.

props.name: target
props.description: Specify a DOM node where the Menu should be rendered in. Defaults to document.body.

props.name: x
props.description: Specify the x position of the Menu. Either pass a single number or an array with two numbers describing your activator's boundaries ([x1, x2])

props.name: y
props.description: Specify the y position of the Menu. Either pass a single number or an array with two numbers describing your activator's boundaries ([y1, y2])

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon MenuItemDivider rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
